If you're looking for **smart lock installation in Flemington, VIC**, here are a few well-reviewed options:

1. SMART LOCK INSTALLATION – Specialises in smart locks and installs a wide range of brands including Yale, Lockwood, Schlage, Aqara, Philips, Samsung, Eufy, Kaadas, and more. They focus specifically on digital lock installations for homes, apartments, and businesses. [www.smartlockinstallation.com.au](https://www.smartlockinstallation.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

2. Lockstar Locksmiths – Local 24/7 locksmith servicing Flemington, offering smart lock supply and installation alongside general locksmith services. [www.lockstarlocksmiths.com.au](https://www.lockstarlocksmiths.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

3. TLC Security Locksmiths – Highly rated locksmith in nearby Essendon that installs digital and smart locks for residential properties.

4. Human Key Locksmiths – Well-reviewed Melbourne locksmith offering residential smart lock installations.

Typical installation pricing in Melbourne is approximately:
- **A$150–A$250** if you already have a compatible smart lock.
- **A$250–A$600+** if modifications to the door or lockset are required, depending on the lock type and door. [www.reddit.com](https://www.reddit.com/r/AusRenovation/comments/1k6kchh?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

Before booking, it's worth confirming:
- The **brand and model** of your smart lock.
- Whether your door is **timber, aluminium, or security screen**.
- Whether you're replacing an existing deadbolt or installing a new one.

If you haven't bought a lock yet, I can also recommend the best smart lock for your door and budget.
